name: Globe Express
summary:
A miniature world on your table. A mail plane in the sky.

Globe Express turns your room into the coziest airmail route on Earth. Anchor a detailed, rotating 3D globe onto your coffee table or float it in mid-air, take the controls of your little mail plane, and connect the continents.
